title: A Training-Free Socket for DNA in Frozen Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.05401v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Connecting a DNA foundation model to a large language model (LLM) usually requires training a connector, and often the LLM too. We show that a closed-form map is enough for gene-level questions. Our method, the socket, fits one ridge regression (the plug) from frozen Evo 2 features to the host LLM's own representation of the gene's symbol, name, and description at an early layer. The plug's output replaces the hidden state at placeholder positions, and no gradient passes through the host.   We test it on GeneHop, a five-way multiple-choice benchmark split by homology. In a single run on the held-out test set, under a frozen analysis plan, real DNA beats shuffled DNA on all four hosts: by +22.2 points [19.8, 25.0] on Qwen3.5-4B, +26.1 [24.3, 27.9] on Qwen3.6-27B, +16.7 [14.2, 19.7] on Mistral-7B, and +18.4 [16.2, 21.0] on OLMo-2-7B. translated_title: 一种面向冻结语言模型中DNA的免训练套接字
translated_abstract: 将DNA基础模型连接到大型语言模型（LLM）通常需要训练一个连接器，并且往往还需要训练LLM本身。我们证明，对于基因级别的问题，一个闭式映射就足够了。我们的方法称为“套接字”（socket），它通过拟合一次岭回归（即“插头”（plug）），将冻结的Evo 2特征映射到宿主LLM在早期层对基因符号、名称和描述的自身表示。插头的输出替换占位符位置的隐藏状态，且没有任何梯度回传到宿主模型。我们在GeneHop上测试了该方法，这是一个按同源性划分的五选一多项选择基准。在冻结分析方案下对留存测试集进行单次运行的结果显示，真实DNA在所有四个宿主模型上都优于打乱后的DNA：在Qwen3.5-4B上提升+22.2分[19.8, 25.0]，在Qwen3.6-27B上提升+26.1分[24.3, 27.9]，在Mistral-7B上提升+16.7分[14.2, 19.7]，在OLMo-2-7B上提升+18.4分[16.2, 21.0]。所有四个结果均通过Holm校正，每个零假设对照都保持在假处理水平两点以内……
tldr: 该论文提出一种免训练的“套接字”方法，仅通过一次闭式岭回归将冻结的Evo 2 DNA特征接入冻结LLM的早期层表示，无需任何梯度训练即可在四个宿主模型上有效回答基因级别问题，真实DNA信号均显著优于打乱DNA对照。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a training-free "socket" that connects frozen Evo 2 DNA features to frozen LLMs via a single closed-form ridge regression, enabling gene-level question answering without any gradient updates, with real DNA significantly outperforming shuffled-DNA controls across four host models on GeneHop.
